id: 488-狄奧多里克大帝征服意大利
theater: 北義大利（維羅納至拉文納戰線）

battle.name: 狄奧多里克大帝征服意大利
battle.theater: 北義大利（維羅納至拉文納戰線）
battle.brief: 西羅馬帝國覆亡後，東哥德王狄奧多里克率部眾越過阿爾卑斯山，兩度進軍義大利，於493年三月迫降奧多亞克。卡面這把斯巴達長矛並未隨軍而至，但它代表的方陣長矛邏輯，正是普羅科匹烏斯筆下哥德人馬其頓式方陣的核心：盾牆前列、雙手平舉長矛，兩翼騎兵與中央步兵互為依靠。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 狄奧多里克大帝征服意大利這場戰爭，交戰雙方都不是單一民族國家，而是帝國崩解後的聯盟對決。東哥德一方，以狄奧多里克本人為王，率領的是自摩西亞與潘諾尼亞南下的東哥德部眾，旗下還有日耳曼、匈奴與阿蘭人的附庸；部眾整體遷徙，婦孺與全部家產同行，因此這支軍隊更像一個移動的國家，而不是一支遠征部隊。指揮系統極簡：國王一人統攝兵、糧與外交，重大決定在軍中集議作出，那句「帶著人民去征服意大利」的宣告，就出現在出發前的點兵場合。奧多亞克一方是西羅馬帝國崩解後在意大利的實權政權：他出身西哥德人的斯基里氏族，母親是匈奴人，公元476年廢黜幼帝羅慕路斯·奧古斯都魯斯之後不稱帝，而以「意大利王」自居，靠一支由匈人、魯吉人、格皮德人與本地羅馬傭兵拼成的聯軍維持統治，羅馬元老院與教會則在夾縫中求存。真正的第三方是東羅馬皇帝：芝諾把義大利的處置權當作籌碼，承諾讓狄奧多里克在意大利取得立足之地，用以分化奧多亞克；阿納斯塔修斯一世即位後同樣不肯放棄意大利的稅源與糧道，卻又不願讓哥德人一家獨大。義大利北部原屬高盧－諾里庫行省，自四世紀末起已被汪達爾人分割三省，行政機構尚存而常備軍已散，城市的守備多賴民兵與傭兵；東羅馬在亞得里亞海與西西里保有海軍，能用封鎖與調撥決定拉文納的命運。
countriesEn: In the war by which Theodoric the Great conquered Italy, neither side was a single nation-state: the contest was between coalitions formed out of the wreckage of an empire. On the Ostrogothic side stood the Ostrogothic people led south from Moesia and Pannonia by Theodoric himself, with Germanic, Hunnic and Alan clients beneath them. The people moved as a whole, women, children and all their possessions going with them, so that this force was less an expeditionary army than a migrating nation. The command structure was extremely simple: the king held the troops, the grain and the diplomacy in his own person, major decisions were taken in assembly, and the famous declaration about conquering Italy with his people was made at the muster before the march. On Odoacer's side was the effective government that had taken over Italy after the collapse of the Western Roman Empire. He came from the Scirian clan of the Visigoths with a Hunnic mother, and after deposing the boy emperor Romulus Augustulus in 476 he did not call himself emperor but king of Italy, holding power with an allied host of Huns, Rugians, Gepids and Roman mercenaries, while the Roman senate and the church survived in the cracks. The real third party was the emperor in the East. Zeno treated the disposal of Italy as a bargaining counter, promising Theodoric a foothold there in order to divide Odoacer, and Anastasius I, succeeding him, was equally unwilling to surrender the tax revenue and the grain of Italy yet equally unwilling to let the Goths grow too strong. Northern Italy had belonged to the province of Gallia et Noricum, which since the end of the fourth century had been carved into three by the Vandals: the administrative apparatus still existed but the standing armies had dissolved, and the defence of the cities rested on militia and mercenaries. The Eastern Empire still kept a fleet in the Adriatic and in Sicily, and could decide the fate of Ravenna by blockade and by dispatch.
people: 這場戰爭的主角是兩位國王，旁邊還站著一位將軍與一群在西羅馬廢墟上活動的羅馬人。狄奧多里克（約454–526）是西哥德王子泰奧德里克·斯特拉波與奧杜爾瓦之子，父親被東哥德部眾所殺，他本人以人質身分長期留在君士坦丁堡，在瓦倫丁尼安三世與狄奧多西二世治下長大，學會拉丁語並被視為半個羅馬人，公元457年靠部眾推舉為王。他登基後先東征巴爾幹，擊敗薩馬提亞人與吉皮德人，又兩度平定赫維人的叛亂，經驗與韌性都是同輩首領中少見的。奧多亞克（約433–493）是西哥德裔、匈人母系的邊地首領，靠傭兵與聯軍接手西羅馬崩解後的真空；他放棄皇帝名號而自稱意大利王，統治維羅納、米蘭與拉文納，還曾以執政官的名義向元老院行禮，維持羅馬形式的門面。奧多亞克的弟弟奧努爾弗斯在493年拉文納城外的追擊戰中陣亡，489年防守北進前哨的將領安薩也在乳山一役敗亡，維羅納的羅馬守將費爾圖爾斯則死在狄奧多里克夜襲入城的那一夜。東羅馬方面，芝諾皇帝在外交上左右逢源，阿納斯塔修斯一世則在狄奧多里克二度入軍時改變立場，鼓勵他再攻。真正左右後世觀感的是狄奧多里克身邊的兩位羅馬文人：掌文書的卡西奧多魯斯主持行政，撰寫《哥特史》殘卷與《墨丘利與瓦切斯》；掌宮務的博愛修斯以《論神聖政府》為哥德人的統治辯護，卻在狄奧多里克晚年被處決。站在君士坦丁堡一邊的普羅科匹烏斯，留下了《戰史》與《建築論》兩部最詳盡的紀錄。教宗蓋拉修斯一世與元老院也派員東去求援，是這場戰爭裡少數仍在運作的羅馬機構。
peopleEn: The central figures of this war were two kings, with a general on the side and a body of Romans going about among the ruins of the West. Theodoric (about 454 to 526) was the son of the Visigothic prince Theodoric Strabo and of Audulfa. His father was killed by the Ostrogothic people; Theodoric himself spent long years in Constantinople as a hostage, growing up under Valentinian III and Theodosius II, learning Latin and being taken for half a Roman, and in AD 457 he was raised to the kingship by his people. After his accession he campaigned in the Balkans, defeated the Sarmatians and the Gepids, and twice put down rising Hunnic warbands; the experience and the staying power he showed were rare among chiefs of his generation. Odoacer (about 433 to 493) was a frontier chief of Visigothic descent and Hunnic maternal blood who took over the vacuum left by the collapse of the West with mercenaries and allies. He abandoned the imperial title and called himself king of Italy, ruled Verona, Milan and Ravenna, and even addressed the senate in the form of a consul, keeping up the appearance of Roman forms. Odoacer's brother Onoulphus was killed in the pursuit outside Ravenna in 493, the commander Ansae who held the northern approaches was defeated at the Mons Lactarius in 489, and the Roman defender of Verona, Fritigern, died on the night Theodoric entered the city by surprise. On the eastern side Zeno turned the diplomacy to his own advantage, while Anastasius I changed his position when Theodoric marched in a second time and encouraged him to attack again. What really shaped the way later generations judged the war were the two Roman writers at Theodoric's side: Cassiodorus, who ran the administration and wrote the surviving fragments of the Gothic History and the treatise on orthography that passed for his; and Boethius, who defended the rule of the Goths in the De monarchia but was executed in the last years of Theodoric. Procopius, who wrote from the side of Constantinople, left the two most detailed records of all, the Wars and the Buildings. Pope Gelasius I and the senate also sent envoys east to ask for help, and were among the few Roman institutions still working in this war.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是斯巴達長矛（多利矛，dory），一柄約兩米長的希臘重裝步兵方陣矛：木製槍身，前端裝葉形鐵矛頭，尾端留有青銅套與尖尾（aichromos 一類），便於插地休息，也可以在盾後撐住槍身；它必須雙手持握，配合圓盾（aspis）與青銅、亞麻製的輕甲使用。公元前八世紀前後的斯巴達與其他希臘城邦，就是靠這種矛與圓盾組成嚴密方陣，公元前334年之後由亞歷山大大帝帶進亞洲。公元489至493年的北義大利，沒有希臘重裝步兵，更沒有斯巴達方陣，因此這件兵器不屬於任何一支實際參戰的部隊。把它放進這場戰爭的裝備表，是因為它代表一套已經被證明有效的戰術邏輯，而這套邏輯恰好出現在普羅科匹烏斯的戰場描述裡：他寫哥德人列陣如「馬其頓方陣」，長矛平舉過肩，盾牌層層相接，兩翼由騎兵掩護而中央由最精銳的步兵壓住。哥德人自己的方陣矛是一種雙手長矛，比 dory 更長更重，配大型木盾，即鐵或青銅包邊、中央有盾紐的長方形或橢圓形 scutum；護具是皮甲、鱗甲與四、五世紀開始出現的鎖子甲，頭盔是尖頂的 spangenhelm 一類，騎兵另配套索與彎刀。除長矛外，哥德人最被看重的是弓箭，普羅科匹烏斯說蠻人是優良射手，弓為反曲的複合弓，鏃分鐵、骨兩種。羅馬方面的攻城與防禦裝備包括弩砲（ballista）、配重投石機（onager）、城牆與塔樓；狄奧多里克一方則用填土築成壘道、造木製攻城塔，最出名的是維羅納之圍中掘地道的做法。運輸靠牛車、馬匹與就地徵糧，拉文納一役還牽涉港口封鎖與築堤駁船。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the dory, the spear of the Greek hoplite phalanx, a shaft of about two metres carrying a leaf-shaped iron head at the front and, at the butt, a bronze socket and point of the aichromos kind, so that the spear could be planted in the ground for rest and propped against the shield while walking; it had to be held in both hands and was used with the round shield, the aspis, and light armour of bronze or linen. Around the eighth century before our era the Spartans and the other Greek poleis built their tight formations out of this spear and this shield, and after 334 BC Alexander carried it into Asia. In northern Italy between 489 and 493 there were no Greek hoplites and certainly no Spartan phalanx, so this weapon belonged to no force that actually fought in the war. It enters the equipment table of this campaign because it stands for a body of tactical doctrine already proved in battle, and that doctrine is exactly what appears in Procopius: the Goths drew up like a Macedonian phalanx, their long spears held level above the shoulder, their shields overlapping, the cavalry covering the wings and the best of the foot holding the centre. The phalanx spear of the Goths was in fact a two-handed spear longer and heavier than a dory, carried with a large wooden shield, a rectangular or oval scutum with an iron or bronze rim and a metal boss; the protection was leather, scale and, from the fourth and fifth centuries, mail, the helmets were pointed spangenhelms, and the cavalry carried lassos and curved swords. Beside the spear, the bow was what the Goths were most noted for: Procopius calls the barbarians excellent archers, using reflex composite bows with iron and bone arrowheads. On the Roman side the siege and defensive equipment included ballistae, onager stone-throwers, walls and towers; Theodoric's side used earth-filled causeways and timber siege towers, and the most famous device was the digging of a tunnel under the walls during the siege of Verona. Transport was by ox cart and horse, with grain taken from the country on the spot, and the business of Ravenna also turned on the blockade of the harbour and on ships dragged over a mole.
tactics: 狄奧多里克的戰術是「帶著整個民族作戰」，這決定了他每一個決定。公元488年秋，他集結摩西亞的部眾，婦孺、牲口與全部家產同行，軍隊在阿爾卑斯山的山道上拉成數十公里的縱隊，側翼沒有掩護，凍餓與掉隊造成大量非戰減員；抵達北義大利後，他在乳山（Monte Lactario，今加爾達湖東岸）迎擊奧多亞克派出的前哨，擊潰安薩率領的聯軍，隨後攻入維羅納。但戰局沒有速決：狄奧多里克反被奧多亞克的大軍包圍在維羅納城下的營地，糧道被切，營養不足，到冬天必須設法脫身。489年冬末他派使節赴君士坦丁堡，同時與奧多亞克達成為期約一年的休戰，得以脫圍；隨即赴君士坦丁堡接受芝諾的盛情款待，東羅馬朝野普遍認為他已臣服，意大利的局勢因此短暫平靜。492年，在阿納斯塔修斯一世的默許之下，狄奧多里克再舉大軍入義大利，這次他不再理會停戰條款。493年的乳山會戰是雙方第二次在同一處交鋒：哥德人結成緊密方陣，長矛過肩，盾牆層層相扣，奧多亞克的聯軍屢次以騎兵衝擊方陣中央而不能突破，方陣緩慢而持續的推進反而把敵軍擠散，追擊戰中匈人騎兵大量被殲。奧多亞克退入拉文納，狄奧多里克隨即以陸軍圍城並以船隊封鎖港口，圍城拖了數月，最後因海陸外援同時斷絕、盟軍背離，於493年3月5日投降。定都拉文納之後，狄奧多里克的作為同樣是戰術性的：他保留羅馬元老院、執政官與稅制，把東哥德部眾分安置在各城邦的莊園與土地，用以取代奧多亞克的匈人聯盟，並在508年與516年先後平定弗拉維塔與蓋納斯的叛亂，穩住新王朝的後方。
tacticsEn: Theodoric's way of war was to fight with a whole people on the move, and that shaped every decision he took. In the autumn of AD 488 he mustered his people in Moesia, and the women, the children, the cattle and all the goods went with them. The column stretched for tens of kilometres along the mountain tracks of the Alps with no cover on the flanks, and cold, hunger and stragglers produced a great deal of loss that was not inflicted in battle. Reaching northern Italy he took up position at the Mons Lactarius, the Monte Lactario on the eastern shore of Lake Garda, and broke the outpost that Odoacer had sent forward under Ansae, then entered Verona. But the decision was not a quick one: Odoacer's host in turn surrounded the camp Theodoric had pitched below Verona, cut his supplies and starved him, and he had to find a way out before the winter closed in. At the end of the winter of 489 he sent an embassy to Constantinople and at the same time came to terms with Odoacer for a truce of about a year, which freed him; he then went to Constantinople and was received with great honour by Zeno, and the court of the East generally took him for a man who had submitted. Italy was therefore quiet for a time. In 492, with the connivance of Anastasius I, Theodoric led his people into Italy again, and this time he ignored the terms of the truce. The battle at the Mons Lactarius was the second meeting of the two armies on the same ground. The Goths formed a close phalanx with the long spears held above the shoulder and the shields locked one behind the other; Odoacer's allies charged the centre of the phalanx again and again with their cavalry and could not break it, and the slow, continuous push of the phalanx was what spread his line, the Hunnic cavalry being destroyed in the pursuit. Odoacer withdrew into Ravenna, and Theodoric at once invested the city by land and sealed the harbour with his ships. The siege dragged on for months, and it was only when help by sea and by land failed together and allies began to leave him that Odoacer surrendered on 5 March 493. Once Ravenna was his capital, Theodoric's acts were strategic too: he kept the Roman senate, the consuls and the taxation, and settled the Ostrogothic people on estates and lands in the cities of Italy so as to replace Odoacer's Hunnic alliances, and in 508 and 516 he put down the risings of Frachitta and of Gainas, securing the new dynasty in the rear.
data: 可核對的數字集中在系年與制度兩端。時間線：狄奧多里克遣使往君士坦丁堡在公元488年，第一次越嶺在488年末至489年之冬，489年與493年兩度在乳山交鋒，493年3月5日奧多亞克在拉文納投降，3月6日在拉文納的塔波爾被處決；狄奧多里克本人以「意大利王」的身分統治到526年8月去世，葬於拉文納的宮殿區，其巨棺蓋的殘塊今日收藏於城內的浴場博物館。制度與文獻：507年《羅塔里法典》（Edictum Rothari）以拉丁文頒布，是日耳曼諸部最早的成文法之一；卡西奧多魯斯約自507年起任王室書記官（quaestor sacri palatii），博愛修斯在524年出任執政官、於526年遭處決；東羅馬皇帝芝諾在位474至491年，阿納斯塔修斯一世在位491至518年。地理：維羅納至拉文納公路約三百公里，狄奧多里克第二次入軍後自乳山直趨拉文納；第一次越嶺的山道縱隊在史料中常被描述為長達數十公里。兵員：普羅科匹烏斯沒有留下可核對的數字，學界一般把狄奧多里克的作戰兵力放在數萬量級，把奧多亞克的聯軍視為相當或更大，並強調雙方都帶著全體部眾與家屬同行。人口與經濟：戰後義大利城市人口銳減，學界對六世紀義大利人口的估計多在數百萬量級，但推算方法差異極大；508年弗拉維塔、516年蓋納斯先後叛亂，以及535年之後東羅馬在意大利幾乎無兵可徵而仍傾國來攻，都是這份人口基礎的直接後果。考古：拉文納的狄奧多里克陵墓、聖亞波里納教堂與1930年代以來對北義大利東哥德墓葬（如烏迪內附近的奇維達萊）的發掘，提供了物質層面的對照。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked sit at the two ends of chronology and institution. The timeline: Theodoric sent his embassy to Constantinople in AD 488; the first crossing of the mountains was in the late autumn and winter of 488 to 489; the two battles at the Mons Lactarius were in 489 and 493; Odoacer surrendered at Ravenna on 5 March 493 and was executed in the tower of Ravenna on 6 March; Theodoric himself ruled as king of Italy until his death in August 526, and was buried in the palace quarter of Ravenna, the fragments of the lid of his great coffin being kept today in the baths museum in the city. Institutions and texts: the Edictum Rothari was promulgated in Latin in 507 and is among the earliest written laws of the Germanic peoples; Cassiodorus held the office of quaestor sacri palatii from about 507, and Boethius was consul in 524 and was executed in 526; the emperors of the East were Zeno from 474 to 491 and Anastasius I from 491 to 518. Geography: the road from Verona to Ravenna is about three hundred kilometres, and after the second entry into Italy Theodoric drove straight from the Mons Lactarius to Ravenna; the column on the first crossing is often described in the sources as stretching for tens of kilometres. Numbers of troops: Procopius leaves no figure that can be checked, and scholarship generally puts Theodoric's field force in the tens of thousands and regards Odoacer's allied host as equal or larger, stressing that both sides marched with their whole people and their families. Population and economy: the cities of Italy were sharply depopulated after the war, and estimates of the population of Italy in the sixth century generally run to the millions but differ enormously according to method; the risings of Frachitta in 508 and of Gainas in 516, and the fact that in 535 the Eastern Empire had almost no soldiers to draw on in Italy and still came with everything it had, are direct consequences of that base. Archaeology: the mausoleum of Theodoric and the basilica of Sant'Apollinare at Ravenna, and the excavations since the 1930s of Ostrogothic cemeteries in northern Italy such as Cividale near Udine, provide the material side of the comparison.
cause: 打起來有四層原因。表層是東哥德人的生存壓力：狄奧多里克在摩西亞與潘諾尼亞面對赫維人、吉皮德人與薩馬提亞人的聯盟，既無土地可分，也無法長期據守多瑙河下游，因此在君士坦丁堡的使團面前，遷徙是唯一出路。第二層是東羅馬的算盤：476年後意大利名義上仍屬東羅馬，芝諾不願直接出兵收復，於是把奧多亞克與狄奧多里克放在同一張棋盤上，許諾在意大利的薩利克法蘭克人與阿勒曼尼人之地安置東哥德人，那是奧多亞克的腹地，希望雙方互相消耗。第三層是奧多亞克自己的打算：他既想借狄奧多里克之矛清理北意大利的蠻族，又不願讓任何一方坐大，因此一度縱容狄奧多里克越嶺，等他打到維羅納才回身抵抗，休戰期間又遠征西西里與達利亞蒂亞以重建自己的威望，這一越界直接撕毀了停戰。476年後，東羅馬在意大利的稅收被外族掠奪與戰事切斷，西部行省的機構在無皇帝狀態下運作，常備軍早已瓦解，奧多亞克與狄奧多里克都沒有能力靠正規軍吃下整個半島。最深的一層是王權合法性：奧多亞克的「意大利王」沒有帝王的授權，靠的只是軍事實力；狄奧多里克則手握羅馬人給的許諾，隨時可以用「替皇帝收回意大利」的名義取代他。
causeEn: There were four layers to the reasons for the war. On the surface was the pressure of survival on the Ostrogoths. In Moesia and Pannonia Theodoric faced alliances of Heruli, Gepids and Sarmatians; he had no land to allot and could not hold the lower Danube for long, so before the embassy at Constantinople migration was his only way out. The second layer was the arithmetic of the Eastern Empire. After 476 Italy still belonged in name to the East, and Zeno had no wish to reconquer it by force, so he set Odoacer and Theodoric on the same board and promised the Ostrogoths the lands of the Salian Franks and the Alamanni in Italy, which were Odoacer's hinterland, in the hope that the two would wear each other out. The third layer was Odoacer's own calculation. He wanted to use Theodoric's spear to clear the barbarian chiefs out of northern Italy, but he did not want any one party to grow too strong, so for a while he let Theodoric cross the mountains and only turned against him once the Goths reached Verona; during the truce he campaigned in Sicily and Dalmatia to rebuild his own prestige, and that going beyond the terms tore the truce up. After 476 the tax revenue of Italy was cut off by plunder and by war, the institutions of the western provinces ran on with no emperor, the standing armies had long since dissolved, and neither Odoacer nor Theodoric had the regular troops to swallow the whole peninsula. The deepest layer was the legitimacy of kingship. Odoacer's king of Italy had no imperial warrant behind it and rested on military force alone, while Theodoric held the promises of the Romans and could at any moment replace him on the title of recovering Italy for the emperor.
impact: 這場戰爭結束了西羅馬在意大利的時代，也開啟了歐洲中世紀第一批日耳曼王國。狄奧多里克沒有廢除羅馬的行政層，也沒有把義大利改造成蠻族部落聯邦：他保留元老院與執政官，徵收稅賦，修復水道與橋樑，普羅科匹烏斯《建築論》記他在拉文納修築水道、城牆與宮殿，在羅馬重開浴場與公共建築，又設學校維持拉丁文教育。結果是一個雙重的國家機器：羅馬的稅制與城市，加上東哥德的土地與戰士。法制上，507年的《羅塔里法典》以拉丁文頒布，讓義大利同時存在羅馬法與日耳曼法，這種混合法域後來被查士丁尼《民法大全》吸收，成為歐洲私法的源頭之一。教會關係更為尖銳：東哥德人信阿里烏派，天主教教宗蓋拉修斯一世與元老院要求宗教自由，515至516年間羅馬城內發生流血衝突，狄奧多里克偏袒本族而使羅馬貴族與他日益疏遠。軍事上，他建立的重騎兵與步兵混合體系，加上羅馬盟友的稅收，養出了一支能與東羅馬對抗的軍力。長期看，狄奧多里克留下的秩序在他526年死後立刻鬆動：兒子阿里納克十歲上即位，攝政的是狄奧多里克之女阿瑪拉桑莎，她在534至535年間被毒殺；533年查士丁尼把整個意大利重新納入帝國的敕令，直接引爆535年起的哥特戰爭，義大利在二十年間再度被戰火掃過，東哥德王國最終亡於554至555年，帝國邊界退回拉文納與那不勒斯。若說這場征服的真正後果，那就是把義大利變成了東西兩方必爭的戰場。
impactEn: This war ended the age of the Western Roman Empire in Italy and opened the first of the Germanic kingdoms of medieval Europe. Theodoric neither abolished the Roman administrative layer nor turned Italy into a federation of barbarian tribes. He kept the senate and the consuls, he levied taxes, he repaired aqueducts and bridges; Procopius records in the Buildings that he built aqueducts, walls and palaces at Ravenna, reopened the baths and the public buildings at Rome, and set up schools to keep Latin letters alive. The result was a dual state machine: the taxation and the cities of Rome, joined to the lands and the warriors of the Ostrogoths. In law, the Edictum Rothari of 507 was issued in Latin, so that Roman law and Germanic law existed side by side in Italy, and that mixed jurisdiction was later absorbed into Justinian's Corpus of Civil Law and became one of the sources of European private law. The relation with the church was sharper still. The Ostrogoths were Arians, and the Catholic pope Gelasius I and the senate demanded religious freedom; between 515 and 516 there was bloodshed in the city of Rome, and Theodoric's favouring of his own faith drove the Roman nobility further from him. In the military sphere, the mixture of heavy cavalry and foot that he established, together with the taxes of the Roman allies, kept in being an army able to stand against the Eastern Empire. In the long run the order Theodoric left behind came apart as soon as he died in 526. His son Arnulf came to the throne at the age of ten, and the regency was his daughter Amalasuntha, who was put to death between 534 and 535. The decree of 533 by which Justinian took all Italy back into the empire set off the Gothic War from 535, Italy was swept by fire and sword once more in the course of twenty years, and the Ostrogothic kingdom finally perished in 554 and 555, the frontier of the Empire falling back to Ravenna and Naples. If the real consequence of this conquest is to be named, it is that Italy became the battlefield on which East and West would have to fight.
result: 第一次入侵（489年）狄奧多里克取勝而未能取城：乳山與維羅納的戰鬥都贏了，但糧草斷絕迫使他接受為期約一年的休戰，他本人則赴君士坦丁堡接受款待，被東羅馬朝野當作已經歸順的附庸。第二次入侵（492至493年）才是真正的解決：乳山再戰，哥德方陣擊潰奧多亞克的聯軍，匈人騎兵在追擊中被大量殲滅，奧多亞克退入拉文納，海陸被封鎖，外援斷絕，於493年3月5日出降，次日被處決於拉文納的塔波爾。狄奧多里克隨即進入拉文納，接掌奧多亞克的王權與財產，以「意大利王」之名統治東哥德王國，直到526年去世。戰果清單很長：奧多亞克的聯盟瓦解，羅馬元老院、稅制與城市自治被保留下來，507年《羅塔里法典》以拉丁文頒布，拉丁法律與日耳曼法律在義大利並行，拉文納成為西地中海的新權力中心。但勝利並非終局：狄奧多里克沒能再對汪達爾人開戰，508年與516年的叛亂說明新王國內部的凝聚力薄弱；526年他一死，幼子阿里納克與阿瑪拉桑莎的攝政立刻被權臣包圍，534年王位落到狄奧多阿德手中，535年查士丁尼的敕令把這場戰爭的成果全部翻案，554至555年最後的戰役之後，東哥德王國在義大利消失。
resultEn: The first invasion of 489 ended in victory without a city taken. The battles at the Mons Lactarius and at Verona were both won, but the cutting of his supplies forced Theodoric to accept a truce of about a year, and he himself went to Constantinople to be honoured there, and the court of the East took him for a vassal who had already submitted. The second invasion, of 492 and 493, was the real solution. There was a second battle at the Mons Lactarius, the Gothic phalanx broke Odoacer's allied host, and the Hunnic cavalry was destroyed in the pursuit; Odoacer withdrew into Ravenna, was shut off by land and sea, and with his help cut off on every side he surrendered on 5 March 493 and was executed in the tower of Ravenna on the following day. Theodoric entered Ravenna at once, took over Odoacer's kingship and his property, and ruled the Ostrogothic kingdom as king of Italy until his death in 526. The list of results is long: the coalition of Odoacer was broken up, the Roman senate, the taxation and the municipal autonomy of the cities were preserved, the Edictum Rothari was issued in Latin in 507, Latin law and Germanic law ran side by side in Italy, and Ravenna became a new centre of power in the western Mediterranean. But the victory was not the end. Theodoric was never able to open a war against the Vandals, and the risings of 508 and 516 showed how weak was the cohesion inside the new kingdom. When he died in 526 his young son Arnulf and the regency of Amalasuntha were at once enclosed by the great men of the kingdom; the throne passed to Theodahad in 534, and the decree of Justinian in 535 annulled the whole result of this war, and after the last battles of 554 and 555 the Ostrogothic kingdom was gone from Italy.
